title: Granola button
description: Soft-cornered pill buttons in the body face, medium weight: an olive brand pill for the main download, an ink-black pill used through the page, an ink hairline outline and a faint hairline pill for the header. Fills deepen or tint on hover over 0.15s.
notes: ink follows the foreground colour, so it flips to a light pill inside dark bands
takes an optional leading and trailing icon
name: granola-button

props.name: href
props.description: where it goes; without it the button is a <button>

props.name: variant
props.description:
brand: the olive Download pill · ink: the ink-black pill used through the page ·
outline: an ink hairline pill (secondary CTA) · soft: a faint hairline pill (header)

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 38px (header) · md: 56px with 14px text · lg: 56px with 16px text

props.name: icon
props.description: an icon before the label (e.g. a lucide icon)

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: an icon after the label (e.g. a down arrow)

props.name: block
props.description: stretch to the width of its container

props.name: type
props.description: for a <button>: the form button type
